938938.title: G6 Hospitality public-surface discovery: Cloudflare gate
938938.content:
Scope: `https://*.g6hospitality.com/`

Reachable in-scope host discovered and assessed: `https://www.g6hospitality.com/`.

Evidence in the Scope-approved HTTP journal: root GET (IDs `d2260a17-9eb2-405a-9e19-9f0d9496f3a0`, `7a457bfe-994a-4819-bce1-d50f17c9dd2f`), robots (`c5b31f7a-50ec-4ca4-ab61-794970a6a35d`), sitemap (`efb941d0-3d91-493c-baa0-bc5de0653ca5`), security.txt (`11994ccd-a36b-4b8e-9a14-1219143463cf`), favicon (`993f0dce-2673-4699-879b-b2a425be5a64`), HEAD root (`9fbca9dc-fe6e-480f-a0d4-3f76de178716`), and OPTIONS root (`176af5df-ea22-4e00-935c-4a0fa8879113`) all returned `403`.

Observed edge technology/controls: `Server: cloudflare`, `CF-RAY`, `cf-cache-status` (`BYPASS`/`DYNAMIC`), `alt-svc: h3=":443"`, and a Cloudflare JS challenge path `/cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/scripts/jsd/main.js` in some responses. A normal Chrome-style GET also received 403.

Gap: The only directly identified in-scope host is Cloudflare-gated; public route/API discovery cannot proceed without a scope-approved interactive/browser session that clears the edge challenge or another approved in-scope host seed. No external hostname enumeration was performed to avoid querying out-of-scope third-party infrastructure.

32ccac.title: OyoOS HTTP-only discovery: reachable redirect hosts and scope barrier
32ccac.content:
Read-only discovery for `http://*.oyoos.com/` found four reachable in-scope subdomains from a 41-name conventional host sweep: `www.oyoos.com`, `api.oyoos.com`, `help.oyoos.com`, and `staging.oyoos.com`.

Each returns HTTP 301 at `/`, `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, and `/.well-known/security.txt`, preserving the path and redirecting to the corresponding `https://<host>/...` URL. No HTML body, links, forms, API route data, JavaScript resources, or parameter names were exposed through authorized HTTP.

Header technologies: `www`, `api`, and `staging` report `Server: AkamaiGHost`; `help` reports `Server: cloudflare`, a `CF-RAY` header, and a `__cf_bm` HttpOnly cookie on the HTTP redirect. OPTIONS `/` produces the same 301 redirect.

The scope proxy explicitly rejected HTTPS (`403 Blocked by approved Scope`) for all discovered hosts, so redirected content could not be followed or mapped. The remaining candidate hostnames returned 502 from proxy and are not treated as confirmed hosts. Raw artifacts: `/tmp/oyoos-discovery/` for this ephemeral run.

ecbfc2.title: OyoRooms HTTP wildcard discovery
ecbfc2.content:
Read-only discovery for exact scope `http://*.oyorooms.com/`.

Observed hosts:
- `www.oyorooms.com`: `GET /` with curl default UA returned `200 text/html` from `AkamaiGHost`, 108-byte empty HTML document, HSTS `max-age=31536000`, `Cache-Control: no-store, max-age=0`. No links, JavaScript, forms, APIs, parameters, or redirects in that representation. Standard discovery paths `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, `sitemap_index.xml`, `.well-known/security.txt`, `favicon.ico`, `manifest.json`, `api`, and `api/` all returned the identical empty 108-byte HTML response (200), so are catch-all behavior rather than confirmed resources. `GET /` with browser-like UA returned `301 Location: https://www.oyorooms.com/`; not followed because task scope is HTTP-only.
- `partner.oyorooms.com`: `GET /` returned `301 Location: https://partner.oyorooms.com/` via `AkamaiGHost`; not followed due HTTP-only scope.
- `api.oyorooms.com`: `GET /` returned `503 Service Unavailable` from `AkamaiGHost`, body says `Service Unavailable - DNS failure`; no endpoint data.
- `staging.oyorooms.com`: `GET /` returned proxy `502`; name was a limited candidate only and is not confirmed as an active application host.

Journal evidence includes `www` root exchange `50239d54-6b0d-4849-8e0c-bbea2ea6e69a` and `partner` root exchange `c0c91e6d-012d-47de-b3e4-3049bebd9356`.

No GET/POST forms, body parameters, query parameters, JS bundles, public API schemas, or application routes were exposed over the in-scope HTTP scheme. Main gap: substantive public applications are only indicated on HTTPS, which is explicitly outside this exact assigned scope.

ebf1db.title: PrismLife public surface map
ebf1db.content:
Target: `https://prismlife.com/` (read-only discovery)

**Confirmed HTML routes (all GET 200):**
- `/` and `/index.html` (identical 91,033-byte static homepage)
- `/investor-relations.html`
- `/governance.html`
- `/annual-reports.html`
- `/annual-returns.html`
- `/general-meetings.html`
- `/ipo-kit.html`

**Homepage surface:** fragment-only navigation: `#home`, `#brands`, `#investors`, `#culture`, `#newsroom`, `#contact`. Other visible sections include property-brand tabs (`data-filter`: `one`, `two`, `three`, `four`), board/team, investor content, culture, technology stack, timeline IDs `2013`, `2015`–`2025`, and a client-side video modal. No forms, inputs, selects, textareas, submitted POSTs, query parameters, or same-origin APIs identified.

**Investor/governance surface:** investor page has a board-bio client modal; governance page has fragment sections `#annual-reports`, `#annual-returns`, `#policies`, `#general-meetings`; IPO page has `#udrhp-section`, `#supporting-section` and client-only document accordions/tabs. Legacy landing pages enumerate report/return/meeting PDFs. PDF link counts: governance 29, IPO kit 60, annual-reports 5, annual-returns 5, general-meetings 39. The linked resources include annual reports FY22–FY26, annual returns FY21–FY25, governance policies, shareholder-meeting notices/transcripts/voting results (2022–2026), UDRHP/industry report, group financial statements FY23–FY25, and material-subsidiary statements. Source-linked directories include `/Shareholders%20Meeting/` and `/Material%20Subsidiaries/`.

**Client assets / API mapping:** homepage loads same-origin `/js/main.js`, `/js/plugins.js`, `/js/globe.js`, `/scss/main.css`, `/css/normalize.css`, `/css/slick.css`; JavaScript also discloses `/img/st1.png` through `/img/st5.png`; CSS references `/fonts/OptimaNovaLTProRegular.otf`. No same-origin XHR/fetch/API calls. `/js/globe.js` uses a cross-origin `fetch` to `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2/countries-50m.json` (not accessed because out of scope). Homepage video source is external `https://assets.oyoroomscdn.com/Prism+-+Launch+AV+(1).mp4` (not accessed); IPO client code has YouTube modal links.

**Technology / hosting evidence:** `Server: AmazonS3` and CloudFront response headers (`X-Cache`, `Via`, `X-Amz-Cf-*`); static HTML/CSS/JS site. Front-end dependencies: jQuery 3.6.0 (local plus CDN fallback), Modernizr 3.6.0, Slick, Globe.gl 2.45.2, Three.js 0.160.0, TopoJSON client 3, GSAP/AOS components in bundled plugins, Google-hosted Host Grotesk/Inter fonts.

**Discovery gaps:** root references `/site.webmanifest`, but GET returned S3 `404 NoSuchKey`; `/robots.txt` and `/sitemap.xml` also returned 404. Direct GET of the source-linked `/Annual_Report_FY26.pdf` timed out after 30s without bytes; PDF resources were catalogued from HTML but not individually downloaded. No redirects observed among successfully retrieved HTML pages.

a8a0f3.title: Leisure Partners discovery evidence
a8a0f3.content:
Scope: `http://*.leisure-partners.net/`

Identified DNS-resolving in-scope labels from a focused common-host survey: `www.leisure-partners.net` (20.203.237.25), `test.leisure-partners.net` (CNAME to `leisure-partners.net`, public IP observed), and `dev.leisure-partners.net` (10.60.128.70 RFC1918). Other investigated common labels (`api`, `app`, `portal`, `auth`, `admin`, `staging`, `booking`, `cms`, `cdn`, `assets`, `static`, etc.) had no A record.

`GET http://www.leisure-partners.net/` → 200 `text/html; charset=UTF-8`, Apache. Static 235-byte page, last modified 2021-12-08, with only two links: `http://www.belvilla.com` and `http://www.dancenter.com` (both outside this child’s exact scope, not followed). No forms, scripts, action attributes, parameters, or APIs disclosed.

Mapped public `www` paths: `/` and `/index.html` → 200 same static document; `/robots.txt` → 200, `User-Agent: *` / `Disallow: /`; `/favicon.ico` → 200 `image/vnd.microsoft.icon` (3,638 bytes); `/sitemap.xml`, `/health`, `/api`, `/api/` → 404 Apache. `OPTIONS /` → 403. Headers: `Server: Apache`, `Strict-Transport-Security`, `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN`, `X-XSS-Protection`, `Referrer-Policy: same origin`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Upgrade: h2,h2c`.

`GET http://test.leisure-partners.net/` → 301 `Location: https://www.test.leisure-partners.net:443/`. HTTPS is not within the supplied HTTP-only scope and was blocked by the scope proxy; `www.test` also did not resolve through the proxy. `GET http://dev.leisure-partners.net/` timed out without a response; it resolves private RFC1918, indicating it is not publicly reachable through the approved proxy.

607d89.title: Motel6 surface discovery — access gap
607d89.content:
Assigned scope `https://*.motel6.com/`. Read-only requests were sent only through the configured Strix proxy.

Observed in-scope host: `www.motel6.com`.

Evidence:
- DNS: `www.motel6.com` resolves via `www.motel6.com.edgekey.net` → `e318420.a.akamaiedge.net` → `23.193.163.10`, `23.193.163.11`, indicating Akamai delivery.
- Proxy TLS connection to `https://www.motel6.com/` completed and presented a certificate with subject `CN=www.motel6.com; O=Oravel Stays Limited`. No HTTP response arrived during 30–60 second GET/HEAD attempts.
- Captured journal `dd0293f6-5783-4074-a2a0-ba1ff412f0be`: scope allowed GET `https://www.motel6.com/` with response status/body null; no forms discovered. Similar no-response entries: root HEAD `b4c6593a-8435-4ca0-9f40-405a7439556d`, `robots.txt` GET `2f1fe992-d95c-448d-818f-a5c91ef88016`, `sitemap.xml` GET `bf4b3efb-c6dc-4db1-a8d3-e0039b3beb4a`.
- Candidate scope subdomains `booking`, `reservations`, and `api.motel6.com` produced proxy 502 CONNECT failures; `mobile.motel6.com` timed out. No response content or journal exchanges were available for route extraction.

No pages, redirects, forms, query/body parameter names, script assets, API schemas, or JavaScript routes could be mapped because the origin delivered no HTTP response via the required scoped proxy. This is a discovery coverage gap, not a security finding.

74ee5b.title: MadeComfy surface map
74ee5b.content:
Read-only discovery for `https://*.madecomfy.com.au/` completed.

- `www.madecomfy.com.au`: Cloudflare/Webflow marketing site. `robots.txt` advertises `/sitemap.xml` with 407 routes: 203 `/airbnb-management/market/{slug}`, 30 `/airbnb-management/airbnb-cleaning/{location}`, 18 case studies, 59 partner pages, 21 development pages, plus management/location/services/legal/referral/contact workflows.
- Public form/API evidence: calculator POST client code to `https://api.madecomfy.com.au/api/v4/leads`, JSON body `{recordOnly,address:{full,suburb,state,postcode,country},property:{bedrooms}}`; fields include `propertyAddress`, `email`, `property_address__c`, `property_country__c`, `property_postcode__c`, `property_state__c`, `property_suburb__c`, `number_of_bedrooms__c`, `weekly_revenue_estimate__c`, `most_recent_conversion_device`, `referrer_id__c`, `company_website__c`. Get-started/developments and partner/referral forms are public; not submitted.
- `book.madecomfy.com.au`: S3/CloudFront Gatsby booking site. Published sitemap includes 1,311 routes (986 `/properties/{slug}`, 322 `/location/...`, `/access/`, `/mystay/`). Browser pass observed `GET /api/v4/suggestions?page[size]=9` 200 at `api.madecomfy.com.au`. Client routes include `/availability?from=`, `/locations?search=`, `/bookings?bookingReference=`, `/bookings?checkIn=`, `/bookings/?bookingId=`, `/checkout`.
- `my.madecomfy.com.au/login`: S3/CloudFront React dashboard. Public login form fields: `userEmail`, `userPassword`; unsubmitted. Bundle declares `https://api.madecomfy.com.au/api/` and protected route templates for bookings, reservations, properties, and events.
- `blog.madecomfy.com.au`: Webflow blog with 289 sitemap entries: 155 articles, 111 resources/glossary routes, 6 tools, 7 category, 4 audience. `www.blog.madecomfy.com.au` redirects 301 to this host. `trust.madecomfy.com.au/refer` redirects 302 to marketing site.
- `api.madecomfy.com.au/` returns 403; identified suggestions endpoint works as above. `helpcentre.madecomfy.com.au` was referenced by dashboard but proxy returned 502 for root and documented paths, leaving it as a reachability gap.

Technology evidence: Cloudflare + Webflow on marketing/blog, Google Tag Manager, Google Maps Places, HubSpot-related forms; Gatsby/S3/CloudFront on booking; React/S3/CloudFront on dashboard; API response server is nginx. No forms submitted and no state-changing requests made.
